workflows.description: Single-input P2WPKH to silent payment workflow (global-share): Creator adds inputs and SP outputs
Single-input P2WPKH to silent payment workflow (global-share): Updater adds UTXO and BIP32 derivation data
Single-input P2WPKH to silent payment workflow (global-share): Signer adds the ECDH shares and DLEQ proofs, computes the silent payment output scripts, signs every eligible input
Single-input P2WPKH to silent payment workflow (global-share): Input Finalizer builds the final scriptwitness
Single-input P2WPKH to silent payment workflow (global-share): Extractor produces the raw transaction
Two-input P2WPKH to silent payment workflow (global-share): Creator adds inputs and SP outputs
Two-input P2WPKH to silent payment workflow (global-share): Updater adds UTXO and BIP32 derivation data
Two-input P2WPKH to silent payment workflow (global-share): Signer adds the ECDH shares and DLEQ proofs, computes the silent payment output scripts, signs every eligible input
Two-input P2WPKH to silent payment workflow (global-share): Input Finalizer builds the final scriptwitness
Two-input P2WPKH to silent payment workflow (global-share): Extractor produces the raw transaction
Two-input P2WPKH to silent payment workflow (per-input-share): Creator adds inputs and SP outputs
Two-input P2WPKH to silent payment workflow (per-input-share): Updater adds UTXO and BIP32 derivation data
Two-input P2WPKH to silent payment workflow (per-input-share): Signer adds its ECDH share and DLEQ proof, wait for every eligible input to have a share before signing (signer 1 of 2)

Two-input P2WPKH to silent payment workflow (per-input-share): Signer adds its ECDH share and DLEQ proof, verifies other DLEQ proofs, computes the silent payment output scripts, signs its input (signer 2 of 2)
Two-input P2WPKH to silent payment workflow (per-input-share): Signer verifies the DLEQ proofs and the output scripts, signs its input (signer 1 of 2)
Two-input P2WPKH to silent payment workflow (per-input-share): Input Finalizer builds the final scriptwitness
Two-input P2WPKH to silent payment workflow (per-input-share): Extractor produces the raw transaction
